properties.title: Konkordiahütte SAC
properties.description:
Spectacular high alpine cabin. The impressive view from the edge of Grosser Aletschgletscher is earned by glacier hikes and finally an ascent on the long stairway up to the eagle’s nest. Regularly enlarged and renovated, the legendary «island in the sea of ice» has been in existence for almost 150 years. Once it was located 50 metres above Konkordiaplatz, today it's 300 metres. In summer as well as winter it is the starting point for a multitude of high alpine and glacier tours. 
Warning: All access routes cross glaciers. Appropriate experience and equipment, or the guidance of a mountain guide, are required.
